title: Intent lock: the owner's keywords are never forgotten
desc: T1 core. The PreToolUse intent lock pauses real work after an owner message (and after every compaction) until a skill search and the skills read cover 70 percent of his keywords. Named in every [intent-lock] refusal. Spec, success measure and the road that clears it (owner 2026-10-15).
steps: DECISION (owner 2026-10-31, PLAN SENTENCE IS THE SECOND KEY): token coverage alone must NOT open the lock. After the search passes and the skills are read, the lock WARNS, never blocks (ROAD 2026-11-03: a ROOT-report turn carries no owner words, so pay the named like first and the turn proceeds; but a ROOT report that quotes the owner verbatim does carry his words, so search them before acting, e.g. 2026-11-04 the SDK ROOT relay of the resummon order) (owner 2026-11-01: make the plan block a warning; the line reaches the model as PreToolUse additionalContext through .claude/hooks/wkharness-run.sh) until the session STATES ITS EXECUTION PLAN: one sentence per intent chain, each quoting that chain intent-strengthening slot (the third slot) VERBATIM and naming on the same line what will be done for it -- a file, a command, or skip plus the reason. Every chain needs its sentence; one missing chain keeps the lock closed. WHY: a session can cover 100 percent of his words and still act on something else, so the plan sentence is what proves the words were understood, and no tag or read can fake it. DECISION: every tool call after an owner message is blocked until a skill search written as standard intent tokens (original=corrected=synonym=english chains, several per search) has run since that message (owner 2026-10-16: if no standard-intent-token skill search follows the user words, block everything; a plain-words search does not count, and right after an owner message the wkappbot skill search command itself is refused as an anti-knowledge pattern when its arguments hold no original=corrected=synonym=english chain (owner 2026-10-16: the refusal text prints one example chain); example: the plain query for the owner-anger skill ranked it last while the chained query ranked it fourth). A skill search that drops a required keyword is refused, and the refusal lists the missing required keywords in the order the owner first said them, to be put IN FRONT of the search. WHEN: the owner said a keyword two or more times in the session (a required keyword) and the newest search lacks it as a Korean left side or as its English right side. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then rerun the search with the missing required keywords first, in order of first appearance, each as a KOREAN=english pair, followed by the last message's pairs (example shape: the intent-lock pair first, then the required-keyword pair, then the skill-search pair). WHY: owner 2026-10-16: block when a required keyword is missing from the skill search and have it put in front in the order it appeared, so the sharp required keywords survive every compaction. //why:three owner turns stacked so every chain got its own plan line //why:gitlab primary question needs plan lines naming each chain-unknown //why:owner panel corrections relayed with red bucket and jump scroll-unknown //why:three owner turns stacked so every chain got its own plan line-unknown //why:untamed root chains got plan lines naming stern order //why:relayed owner order through SDK root never fired my lock //why:web served harness chains got their plan line before relaying //why:signaler order searched then relayed with the wksig name

DECISION: a modifier phrase may stay one sharp keyword, joined by hyphens on both sides, and a tag may be written the same way (ROAD 2026-11-03: when the lock refuses a bare verb chain, prefix the owner word that precedes it, e.g. 작전-짜시오 and 레포에서-관리되게하삼 passed at 100 percent). WHEN: the owner's key noun carries adjectives or adverbs (example: the Korean for very-smart-opus written as three hyphen-joined Korean words, paired with very-smart-opus). HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then write the pair hyphen-joined in his word order. ROAD: an owner line typed into the wrong seat is relayed verbatim to the seat he meant, example 2026-11-04: the portal ROOT got 내말들 대변인한테 전해주셔 and sent both owner lines word for word to the spokesman by send_message, with its own notes below them.; the release test splits the Korean side on hyphens and counts the pair when every piece is in the owner text (substring or one edit away), and splits the English side the same way, counting it when the whole phrase or every piece is a tag of the read skills; a hyphen-joined Korean tag counts when every piece occurs in the owner text. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: describe the modifying words with hyphens, Korean included, register tags the same way, so sharply described keywords become possible and a modifier never turns into a missing keyword. //why:special order relay from the sdk root cleared with chained hyphen keywords //why:particle-fixed corrected slots cleared the eleven chain search-unknown //why:owner trading integration approval arrived mid draft and hyphen chains cleared it-unknown //why:special order relay from the sdk root cleared with chained hyphen keywords-unknown //why:evidence-per-paragraph and shared-logic chains cleared the owner message lock

DECISION: the intent lock pauses the first real tool call after an owner message until his words have found their skills (and when an owner sentence lands in a session whose repo does not own it, answer his question briefly in that session and relay only the execution: 2026-11-02 the landscape-proposal question reached the kih WebVM root, which gave the opinion and handed the PDF work to the spokesman). WHEN: an [intent-lock] refusal arrives, or a new owner message with 2+ Korean words, or the first call after a compaction (ROAD 2026-11-03: a joking owner idea with a trailing laugh mark still gets the full chain search first, and the idea itself becomes a ledger line the same turn, e.g. the issue-write-only signaling token became phase 1B). HOW: translate his key Korean words into 3+ English words and run wkappbot skill search WORD1 WORD2 WORD3, read the governing skill it finds with wkappbot skill read ID, and when his words are missing from its tags add them with wkappbot skill edit ID --tags (copy the existing tag line first, --tags replaces it; there is no --add-tags flag, so paste the old line plus the new chains in one --tags call); skill search, read and edit are never locked, so the lock is always satisfiable. AN UNJUST REFUSAL IS THE LOCK'S BUG, NOT THE READER'S FAULT (owner 2026-10-16: an unjust block is a bug, heal the reflex so no intelligence turns rebellious): when a missing word cannot honestly be tagged (a pronoun such as 얘는, a word glued to a particle such as 오퍼스인데, an interjection), say so in one line of the reply, add only honest tags, and keep working; never fake a tag and never resend the same call to burn the 3-refusal release, and a release after 3 refusals is itself a bug (owner 2026-10-16: delete the cap code), so no count ever releases the lock: the only exit is the honest road the refusal prints, and resending the same call is ignoring the guidance (owner 2026-10-16, to a new Opus spokesman that resent one Agent dispatch three times: this rookie ignores the guidance and charges); when honest tags still read as missing, find out why (particle suffix, filler word, the tag edit not reaching the scanned skill roots) before the next call; ROAD for a follow-up owner line that refines an order already sent: fold it into the same open PR order instead of a second PR (2026-11-04 tier map into the owner-login PR); road that works (2026-10-16): when the missing required keywords are wrapper words such as command, haiku or name that no skill can honestly carry, run ONE pair search, name the lock's bug in one line, and stop dispatching instead of repeating the call (a spokesman burned six dispatches and filled its session with search lists). TODO (measured 2026-10-16, seat 9387fef4): (a) slash-command echo rows (command-name, command-message, command-args, local-command-stdout of /clear and /model) are read as owner rows, so command, message, args, name, model, stdout and local became REQUIRED keywords and filled 8 of the 12 rule-1 slots, a ring no honest search clears; exclude those tags in the owner-row filter of Test-WkOwnerKeywordSearch.ps1 line 209; (b) the search capture counts option tokens such as --keep as search words; peel options and read past leading global options (wkappbot --keep X skill search WORDS); (c) the Claude entry wkharness.ps1 never calls Invoke-WkEmergencyEditEarly and its Block never stamps the repair list, while the codex main does both, so a Claude session can never repair a refusing guard (owner 2026-10-16: the emergency door runs before the on-load lock, that is the standard). WHY: owner 2026-10-15, design intent: the intelligence never forgets the keywords the owner said, across turns and across compactions; every Korean tag added is a gift that lets the next intelligence find the governing skill at once (dae-dae-son-son hongik). //why:auto-install trace search cleared after particle-free corrected slot //why:bake wait question searched then routed to webvm root //why:owner retyped the cookie and portal-link line directly, so the private sign-in link plan answers him in this seat //why:intent panel chain parser must read the real search command line the same way-unknown //why:npm postinstall harness verify order passed after json unguarded remark search-unknown //why:owner retyped the cookie and portal-link line directly, so the private sign-in link plan answers him in this seat-unknown

DECISION: clear an [intent-lock] refusal with ONE search built from the refusal itself (2026-11-02: an owner line meant for another root reached the kih WebVM root; one filled retry line cleared it, then the root stopped its landscape-export sector because the owner said that job was not its). WHEN: any [intent-lock] refusal. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then write ONE search in this order: first every word the refusal lists as required, plain and in its order (ROAD 2026-11-02: an owner line repeated after an earlier pass re-locks with the OLD chains plus the new ones, so reuse the earlier filled chains verbatim and append the new ones, as the refusal retry line itself does); then the nouns of the owner's last message as owner-word=english pairs; keep the total token count inside the band the refusal prints (need A to B); for each listed word no read skill carries, add it as a t- tag on intent-lock (ROAD 2026-11-03 owner panel design: the portal intent panel shows one button per chain by its third slot, greys to green as skills cover it, and gathers uncovered words in one leftmost bucket; find a dashboard by its owning repo first, e.g. SPOKESMAN.md named the portal panel PRs 26-29 in skhy-clush) (step on temporary tags) and re-read intent-lock; put any option before the subcommand, as in wkappbot --keep X skill search WORDS. When the owner message holds a long paste, first pull it verbatim from the session transcript (grep the jsonl for its first words; a short reply such as a URL request still owes chains for the previous owner message, since the lock also scores the newest-but-one turn: 2026-10-31 a 4-chain search scored 38 percent) and build every adjacent-word chain from that text in one search, giving each chain a corrected slot that differs from the original and dropping chains the refusal marks as used twice (2026-10-29: a 40-line meeting notice passed at 96 percent this way after five partial rounds). When the required words alone outnumber the band's upper bound, the lock is in a ring: name it in one line, keep healing reflexes with skill edits (never locked) and wait for the owner's next message, whose length widens the band; the same holds when a stop frame reads a stale local letter after the real one landed on main: answer once, briefly, and wait (2026-10-29: the letter was on main at 61dbca0 while the session branch still held the old one). WHY: 2026-10-16 the spokesman cleared the lock in one call with 8 required words plus 4 pairs once those words carried t- tags, after trailing --keep and a 13-token search had each been refused. //why:owner asked status pull test docs single search cleared //why:gloss question cleared after the retry line filled every slot-unknown //why:six hour runner order arrived mid compaction and one filled chain search cleared it-unknown //why:owner asked status pull test docs single search cleared-unknown

DECISION: a pair may carry synonyms as a chain, owner-word=synonym=english, and the chain still counts as ONE token (2026-11-01: a chain an accepted reply already covered must drop out of both the lock and the stop coverage; until that lands a one-line answer needed 120 chains, fix ordered to the kih harness root). WHEN: a keyword has a near-synonym the owner may say next time, or a tag should be found by two Korean words. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then write the chain left to right: the first side is the owner's (typo-corrected, hyphen-joined if modified) word and must be in the owner text, the middle sides are synonyms that need not be (any number of them, ten or more is fine, in ANY language; STANDARD INTENT TOKEN, Korean name 표준의도토큰 (owner 2026-10-16: the official term for this notation, call each chain a standard intent token): original=typo-corrected=synonym=english, where a slot that repeats an earlier spelling is skipped (a=a=b is just a=b, and an already-English owner word may stand alone), the checker splits on equals, drops duplicates case-insensitively, takes the first as the owner side and the last as the English tag side (the lock also stands down SILENTLY on four paths: WK_INTENT_LOCK=0, wkappbot off PATH, the V2 module unloaded, no wkhippo rows; so a session showing zero [intent-lock] refusals is unproven, not compliant -- 2026-10-24 the PC spokesman ran no chain search in 100 events); every slot may itself be a hyphen chain of several modifiers (ROAD 2026-11-03: a new tag while the lock is active must be a CORRECTED=ENGLISH pair copied from the passing search, e.g. 노란색이-반짝이면-어떤가=yellow-sparkle passed while invented pairs were refused) (owner 2026-10-16: each word takes many modifiers joined by hyphens; ROAD 2026-11-03: read the modifier before the noun as part of the meaning, e.g. 일분안에 신호 있었으면 means a signal seen within the last minute, not the first minute of the session, which the spokesman first misread; ROAD 2026-11-03: when the owner later resends his lines as one full message, re-read every condition word against what was relayed, e.g. 덜 바쁠때만 reversed the edit-mode rule and the correction went out the same minute), and the checker splits each slot on hyphens and counts a slot when every piece matches (ROAD 2026-11-03: when the owner resends a question already relayed, confirm it against the ledger and the howto spec instead of opening a new item, e.g. the plan-cited gloss question); the typo-corrected slot applies to EVERY language (owner 2026-10-16: an English typo is fixed in the corrected slot too, and French or Spanish owner words follow the same principle), so the corrected spelling is just another middle slot of the standard intent token, Korean, English or other, owner 2026-10-16: similar words may be registered many times and are language-free), and the last side is English and must match a read-skill tag (whole or by hyphen pieces); register the synonyms as tags too so the next search finds the skill by either word. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: allow similar vocabulary to be registered twice, modified-word1=similar-word1=english-keyword1, so one meaning is found by every word that names it. //why:db runner connect question cleared with seven synonym chains in one search //why:a tag refused until it reused a pair from the passing search-unknown //why:pull paused for a pending like after the panel spec closed-unknown //why:db runner connect question cleared with seven synonym chains in one search-unknown //why:busybox per-app wasm message cleared with ten filled chains

DECISION: a search token that finds no fitting skill gets a TEMPORARY TAG on this intent-lock skill to pass the lock, and those temporary tags are healed periodically. WHEN: the lock lists a required or owner keyword that no governing skill carries. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, copy its tag line, append the missing words each prefixed with t- (owner 2026-10-16: temporary tags carry a t- prefix so a heal pass finds them by grep, and the lock still matches them by substring; example t-command), run wkappbot skill edit intent-lock --tags with the whole line, re-read it and rerun the standard-intent-token search. ROAD for a bare number word: glue the owner word that precedes it onto it, and give the same-language slot a new phrase rather than the old one minus its modifier (2026-11-04 burst-poll order passed on the second search); at each heal pass (descent or the nightly heal) move each temporary tag to the skill that truly governs the word or delete it, above all the tags a since-fixed lock bug forced. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: register temporary tags on the intent-lock skill to break through a token with no fitting skill, and heal the added tags periodically; the same day the tags command, message, args, name, model, stdout, local and clear cleared a ring caused by slash-command echo rows. (and in a demo the hold is shown with the threshold set only for that scene and reset after, e.g. 2026-11-02 the portal QA video fipy hold) //why:temporary tags carried the parallel-sector and dotnet-first-call chains //why:smart signaler words tagged onto skhy core skill //why:farewell message needed many filled synonym chains today-unknown //why:fifth sector today lost its yaml parse check to the lock-unknown //why:smart signaler words tagged onto skhy core skill-unknown //why:demo readiness question searched before checking the live site //why:repeated owner lines searched again before resending the answer

DECISION: a sector clears the lock with the ready search line its brief carries for its short English Goal line. WHEN: dispatching any sector. HOW: put the GOAL line and its filled search first in the brief, as intent-lock-howto step 3 shows. WHY: the 2026-11-01 F2F3 sector cleared it on its first call. OPEN: Get-WkIntentPendingState keeps only a passing query, so a failing sector search's Reason is dropped and the sector sees the generic RETRY LINE. //why:retry line for the intelligence test remark cleared the stop debt //why:notification turn still owed one intent lock like payment-unknown //why:hippocampus quip cleared with one short db world chain-unknown //why:retry line for the intelligence test remark cleared the stop debt-unknown //why:docs security structure order passed after one long filled chain search

DECISION: no word-count threshold decides whether an owner message is judged; and a numeric THRESHOLD for a gate (e.g. the portal intent-lock keyword-coverage percent) is an owner-spec constant the spokesman PROPOSES, never fixes unasked -- 2026-10-31 I put 25% in a brief on my own, which was wrong. WHEN: the host or the release test meets an owner message of one or two words. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then judge every owner message with at least one content word, Korean or English; a short message borrows prior keywords in front instead of being skipped. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: the two-words-or-fewer skip (the old 2+ Hangul words trigger) is patch code and the seed of a big bug someday, so delete it; ordered into the v9 sector the same minute. (2026-11-02: the QA video hold scene for the spokesman plan that drops fipy) //why:notification-only turn still owed the intent lock like payment //why:notification turns carry no owner words yet the lock debt still asks a like //why:two owner messages merged into one search before the SDK read-unknown //why:repeated short owner question still searched and judged-unknown //why:notification turns carry no owner words yet the lock debt still asks a like-unknown

RESULT (kih a9111c6c4, b3750ddbd, 4f1b2513b; v7 selftest 12/12): OWNER DESIGN 2026-10-16 for the release test, replacing the Korean-word coverage count. STILL OPEN: the host captures the newest search with a loose regex that can grab an Agent prompt mentioning a search, so the spokesman PC keeps the module out of the live tools folder until that capture is narrowed to wkappbot skill search commands. WHEN: the intent lock has refused and the intelligence answers with a skill search, or a peer report quotes the owner verbatim (ROAD: search that quote before acting, e.g. 2026-11-04 the SDK ROOT relay of the resummon order). ROAD for a repeated owner question: run the same filled search once and answer with the earlier answer shortened, no new order (2026-11-04: the db-runner connect question came twice); a joke that names one option, such as the signaler gets busy, is the owner pick and is ordered at once. HOW: run wkappbot skill read harness-stop-guard, then build in kih tools/wkharness-claude-stop/Test-WkOwnerKeywordSearch.ps1 (proto plus selftest under .tmp) three checks: (1) the search after the refusal is a literal English translation of the owner message made by the intelligence itself, never by a translator tool, so the translation IS the extraction of his key keywords: keep the owner's word order, translate each key word on its own, and pass those English words in that order as the arguments of wkappbot skill search, keeping a word in Korean when it has no literal translation, written as PAIRS in his word order, KOREAN=english, with the Korean side typo-corrected; when his last message is too short to carry its intent, put the important keywords of his earlier messages IN FRONT, then the last message's words (owner 2026-10-16: if the last user message is not long enough, insert the key words of past messages at the front of the search); and every keyword the owner said TWO OR MORE TIMES in the session is a REQUIRED keyword that must appear in the search, as the Korean left side of a pair or as its translation, so no repeated keyword can be dropped (owner 2026-10-16: the goal is to miss not one important keyword; a keyword that appears twice or more becomes required) (owner 2026-10-16: list each keyword as typo-corrected-word=English word; example wkappbot skill search 스킬서치=skill-search 키워드=keyword 오타보정=typo-correction, which the search CLI already splits and which ranked intent-lock second live), so the gate checks the left side against the owner text (substring or one-edit typo distance) and the right side against the English tags, pair by pair (owner 2026-10-16; the verdict must receive ALL tags of the read skills, English included: the first landing a9111c6c4 passed the Hangul-only tag list and scored every English search 0, fixed by b3750ddbd; and a dispatched brief counts as the owner message, so a 367-word brief made the plus or minus 30 percent band unreachable for every sector, so rule 1 caps the band at 3 to 12 tokens when the owner text is longer than 12 content words, built as v6 under kih .tmp/intent-lock-v6 while the live module stays out), with an English word count within plus or minus 30 percent of the owner message content-word count; (2) at least 70 percent of that search's English keywords appear as tags of the skills read since the refusal; (3) a Korean tag counts only when it occurs as a substring of the owner's original text, so a tag matches his words even with a particle attached and a made-up tag never counts. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: translate the user's words into English of similar word count for the search, check that 70 percent of the search keywords appear as tags, and check Korean tags against the user's original text; measured the same day, two Agent.cmd sectors died on form-label words the coverage count could not honestly clear. //why:v7 landed on origin, live enable waits on capture fix //why:pair search ranked intent-lock second on first try-opus //why:two sectors deadlocked until module pulled-opus //why:v7 landed on origin, live enable waits on capture fix-opus
